guideTitle: The Best Hexagon Desk Pads, from Honeycomb Prints to Full-Desk Mats
metaTitle: Best Hexagon and Honeycomb Desk Pads (2026)
metaDescription: These desk pads are rectangular with hexagon honeycomb prints. We compared five on size, surface, coating and base so you can pick the right pattern at the right size.
introParagraphs: One clarification first: all five pads here are rectangular with a hexagon honeycomb print, not cut in a hexagon shape. If you want a pad that is itself hexagonal, these won't be it.

Among the honeycomb prints, the practical choice is size. Two are 31.5 x 11.8 inches, which covers a keyboard and mouse on a shallow strip; three are 35.4 x 15.7 inches, which covers more of the desk. All use cloth surfaces, some with a waterproof coating.
All five cost under $20 at the time of writing. Our comparison is based on listed dimensions and materials, not hands-on testing.

best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-1.badge: Blue and Red Honeycomb, Standard Size
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-1.summary: A 31.5 x 11.8-inch, 3mm-thick cloth pad with a blue-and-red hexagon honeycomb print.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-1.description:
This pad prints a blue-and-red honeycomb pattern on a 31.5 x 11.8-inch cloth surface, 3mm thick, enough to cover a keyboard and mouse.

Its 11.8-inch depth is shallower than the XXL pads here, so it won't reach under a monitor.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-1.bestFor: A keyboard-and-mouse strip with a honeycomb look.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-1.skipIf: You want more coverage; the XXL pads are 35.4 x 15.7 inches.

best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-2.summary: A 35.4 x 15.7-inch blue honeycomb pad with waterproof coating and rubber base.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-2.description:
The blue XXL honeycomb pad covers more of the desk, 35.4 x 15.7 inches, with a superfine cloth surface, a waterproof coating that wipes clean and a non-slip rubber base.

It's the same design as the red XXL pad at the same price; choose by color.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-2.bestFor: A full keyboard-and-mouse area in blue.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-2.skipIf: You prefer red; the red XXL pad is identical.

best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-3.summary: A 31.5 x 11.8-inch, 3mm gold honeycomb cloth pad, the cheapest here.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-3.description:
The gold honeycomb pad is the least expensive here, under $10 at the time of writing: 31.5 x 11.8 inches, 3mm thick, with a gold hexagon print.

Like the other 31.5-inch pad, it's shallow and covers keyboard and mouse only.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-3.skipIf: You need a deeper surface; an XXL pad covers 15.7 inches.

best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-4.summary: The red version of the 35.4 x 15.7-inch waterproof-coated honeycomb pad.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-4.description: This is the red counterpart of the blue XXL pad: 35.4 x 15.7 inches, superfine cloth with a waterproof coating, and a non-slip rubber base, at the same price at the time of writing.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-4.bestFor: A full keyboard-and-mouse area in red.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-4.skipIf: You prefer blue; the blue XXL pad is identical.

best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-5.summary: A 35.4 x 15.7-inch red honeycomb "science technology" print with a smooth, soft surface.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-5.description:
This pad offers a different red honeycomb design at 35.4 x 15.7 inches, with a smooth, soft surface and printing the maker describes as high-definition.

It was the most expensive pad here at the time of writing, by a dollar. The listing summary doesn't mention a waterproof coating or base type.
best-hexagon-shaped-desk-pads-5.skipIf: You want a waterproof coating; the blue or red XXL pads list one.

faq.a: No. They're rectangular with hexagon honeycomb prints.
35.4 x 15.7 inches if you want keyboard, mouse and some desk covered; 31.5 x 11.8 inches for a narrower strip.
The blue and red XXL pads list a waterproof coating; others don't mention one.
The XXL pads list rubber bases; check the others' listings.
They use cloth surfaces designed for mice; performance details aren't specified.

bottomLine: For the most coverage and spill protection, the blue or red XXL honeycomb pads are the practical choice. The gold 31.5-inch pad is the lowest-cost option.
If you specifically want a hexagon-cut pad, none of these fit that brief.
